display_title: Star, Please Grant Me Your Wish

titles_en.title: Star, Please Grant Me Your Wish

description:
Dan (seme) is in love with Yuso (uke), but Yuso rejects the gloomy Dan. Obsessed with finding a “well-endowed partner,” Yuso has one-night stands every day, and on the night of a shooting star, he wishes to finally meet one—while Dan, instead, wishes to be with Yuso. The next day, Yuso ends up using a dildo delivered to his doorstep. But as Yuso grows addicted to it, Dan, who has somehow become connected to the dildo, begins sharing in the unknown sensations, and the two find themselves enduring exhausting nights together…
